observed_problem.example: At the E2 snapshot, workpackages/STATE.json says F2-WP-301=NOT_STARTED while granular WP301 reconciliation/receipt evidence records state=ACCEPTED at deterministic repository-hosted CI scope; a prior Trigger-6 fusion already recorded the contradiction.
observed_problem.consequence: Aggregate-only consumers can duplicate work, route stale dependencies, or understate/overstate maturity. Manual repair does not remove the recurrence mechanism.

adopt: authoritative granular records remain source; aggregate views are disposable/rebuildable projections
single projector owns projection output; direct independent status mutation is forbidden
projection version and processing/freshness checkpoint are explicit
rebuild from authoritative inputs is a normal correctness operation
ordering gaps/conflicts prevent unsafe progress claims
external_pattern_distillation.reason: F2 needs the projection invariants, not a new database/framework. A Python-stdlib deterministic projector over repository evidence is lower dependency and token/runtime cost.

critical_semantic_delta.old_shape_risk: One scalar status cannot faithfully represent an accepted prior scope plus a newer active generation.
critical_semantic_delta.new_shape: Separate current_generation_state from highest_accepted_generation/accepted_scopes. Human shorthand may render one marker, but machine state must preserve both dimensions.
critical_semantic_delta.promotion_rule: ACCEPTED_AT_SCOPE requires supported, mutually consistent terminal reconciliation/receipt evidence at the claimed generation and scope. Component/CI acceptance never mints runtime, physical-host, GRID10, effect, training or whole-system credit.
critical_semantic_delta.conflict_rule: Conflicting same-generation terminal artifacts, broken cross-references, unsupported schemas, or ambiguous generation precedence fail closed to CONFLICTED/STALE rather than latest-file-wins.
critical_semantic_delta.not_started_rule: NOT_STARTED is valid only when no supported active/claim/receipt/reconciliation evidence exists for the workpackage; absence of a fresh aggregate literal is not evidence of NOT_STARTED.

projection_ownership.machine_view: workpackages/STATE.json or a successor STATUS_PROJECTION.json becomes projector-produced derived state, not independently maintained authority.
projection_ownership.human_view: WORKPACKAGES.md status markers should be rendered from the same projection result or mechanically verified against it; descriptive prose may remain human-maintained.
projection_ownership.direct_edit_policy: CI recomputation must detect divergent manual status edits.

acceptance_falsifiers: Known WP301 stale-aggregate fixture must project accepted repository-CI scope from granular evidence without runtime promotion.
Known WP302 stale-aggregate fixture must behave analogously when exact terminal artifacts support it.
A higher active generation after a lower accepted generation must preserve prior accepted scope while reporting current generation IN_PROGRESS.
Two contradictory terminal records for the same generation must produce CONFLICTED and no acceptance promotion.
A reconciliation referring to a missing/mismatched receipt must fail closed.
Unknown evidence schema must be surfaced as unsupported, never silently ignored when it can affect status.
Repeated rebuild from the same input manifest must be byte-identical except explicitly excluded timestamp fields; a canonical digest form should exclude volatile display time.
Input order permutation must not change canonical projection content.
Component-CI acceptance with runtime_execution_observed=false must leave runtime_credit=0.
Manual mutation of generated machine/human status must fail projection-consistency CI.
Projector version change must change projector identity and force explicit rebuild/review rather than reinterpret old output silently.

resource_model.expected_complexity: O(number of workpackage evidence records) deterministic local scan; optional per-workpackage incremental manifest later only if measurement justifies it.

counterhypotheses.statement: Periodic manual reconciliation is sufficient and cheaper.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: If drift recurs after manual repair or multiple aggregate-only workers route duplicate work, deterministic projection has positive coordination value. Existing WP301/WP302 drift is already one recurrence signal, not yet a measured cost benchmark.

counterhypotheses.statement: Git commit chronology alone can determine workpackage status.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: Merge/commit messages are not typed evidence scope; accepted state requires exact bound receipt/reconciliation fields and must preserve runtime-credit boundaries.

counterhypotheses.statement: One scalar workpackage status is enough.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: Construct accepted generation N plus active generation N+1; any scalar either erases accepted scope or hides active work.

architecture_delta.change: Replace independent manual aggregate-status authority with one deterministic, rebuildable, evidence-bound WorkpackageStatusProjection; preserve aggregate files as derived views only.
architecture_delta.authority_change: No new truth authority; this removes accidental aggregate authority.
architecture_delta.runtime_change: None until Trigger-4 builds/tests the projector.

next_exact_action: Claim E5_BUILD_CANDIDATE and hand Trigger-4 a bounded source-only implementation/test packet for a stdlib projector under F2-WP-002; no runtime or whole-system promotion.
